surface: src/plate_core/plate_config.py, src/plate_core/data/plate_extensions.yml, src/plate_core/cli.py, src/plate_core/mcp_server.py, src/plate_core/migration.py, docs/design/plate-root-config-schema-lifecycle.md, plugin/agents/plate.agent.md
summary: Add built-in extension manifest precedence, schema v1.1 upgrade helpers, and `gh plate config upgrade` / MCP parity for root `.plate` files.
migration_impact: Repositories with older `.plate` files can now upgrade them to schema v1.1 and inspect built-in extension contributions before local overrides are applied.
migration_guidance: 1. Run `gh plate config show --json` to see whether your `.plate` file reports `upgrade_available` or any enabled built-in extension contributions.
2. Run `gh plate config upgrade --apply` (or MCP `plate_config_upgrade` with `apply=true`) to rewrite older schema v1.0 files to v1.1.
3. Re-check the resolved config after upgrade; built-in extension manifests now contribute config before local overrides, and list-valued fields use replacement semantics.
